# Vendored dependency

`xlsx-0.20.3.tgz` is the official SheetJS Community Edition Node package downloaded from:

`https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz`

SHA-256: `8dc73fc3b00203e72d176e85b50938627c7b086e607c682e8d3c22c02bb99fe8`

SheetJS recommends vendoring its authoritative CDN tarball because the public npm registry package is stale.
